name: generated-visual-discovery
goal: Emit stable discoverable visual case identities while retaining every generated state and viewport.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generated initial pages and page, layout, component and partial state matrices use computed Playwright titles; Harness discovery reports them as unresolved dynamic cases.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing project-template and piece-generator cases check screenshot text and viewports but never require discovery to enumerate stable qualified case identities. Strengthen those cases without adding test titles.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only cb05e2b5e5 strengthened existing generator cases; Harness red da2ad0f7a987 failed because visual case titles remained computed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Source-only 5602697531 emits literal viewport and state titles, sharing the existing assertions and screenshot behavior without changing the runtime matrix.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged cases passed Harness green e4fcb1ed4831 at 5602697531 with the same command and environment as red.

steps.title: Reject and restore the original computed registration.
steps.evidence: Original source mutant 263d42bad1 failed capture 994c109bd592 on both discovery assertions; restored 906a7b7a50 passed 0d079edfe15e with the same complete tree as 5602697531.

steps.title: Retain source and focused workload observations.
steps.evidence: At 5602697531, app contract template bytes/lines/complexity/dependencies were 6956/76/13/0 and project tests 6222/110/7/5; both are modules without separate artifacts. Focused capture e634713df208 retains generation timing and whole-worker RSS.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
